candidates.title: The Snow Trail That Disappeared
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the rescue team's trail markers vanished overnight before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they set larger flags but the next morning those were buried too; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized wind from the narrow pass had piled snow against the markers; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they moved the route to a sheltered ridge and recorded its landmarks, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Compass That Pointed to the Dock
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the harbor compass pointed toward the dock instead of north before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they recalibrated it but the needle turned back toward the pier; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a newly installed iron winch was disturbing the needle; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they moved the compass station away from the winch and checked bearings, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Museum Drawer That Jammed
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the museum's specimen drawer would not open before an exhibition before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they pulled the handle harder but the wood began to crack; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a paper label had slipped behind the drawer rail; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they removed the label with a thin tool and opened the drawer gently, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
